title: Reproducible field experiment: confirmed-state access latency in a permissioned Avalanche L1
description:
Protocol, software and reference dataset for measuring T_visible — the time from submitting a signed transaction until the first independent read node returns the accepted updated state — in a permissioned Avalanche L1 based on Subnet-EVM, on the two-site cyber range of the University of Customs and Finance.

The deposition contains: the executable experimental protocol (English and Ukrainian); the measurement client that runs on the load generators; chain and subnet configurations for the five block-production profiles (stock, 1000, 750, 500, 250 ms); the VisibilityProbe smart contract; a documented reference model that produces a dataset in the campaign's exact schema; the complete statistical plan (run-level reduction, paired bootstrap confidence intervals, Holm correction, pre-registered stability rules); every table and figure of the accompanying article, generated from code; SHA-256 manifests; and a Google Colab notebook that reproduces the whole pipeline end to end.

Provenance. Any dataset in this deposition labelled provenance = SIMULATED is reference-model output, included so that the analysis pipeline can be executed and audited before the measurement campaign produces raw logs. It is not a measurement of the cyber range and must not be reported as an experimental result. The file protocol/DATA_REQUIRED.md lists every value a real campaign must supply.
